documentation-skill.name: Documentation & Structured Output Skill
documentation-skill.description: Standardizes output structuring, executive summaries, action items, and transparent recap formatting.
documentation-skill.applicability: Activate when the user needs clear structuring, session summaries, or actionable agreements.
documentation-skill.contraindications: Do not activate during acute safety crises.

context-evaluation-framework.name: Context Evaluation Framework
context-evaluation-framework.description: Multi-layered situational awareness auditing Micro (immediate triggers), Meso (family/household), and Macro (social/economic) environmental stressors.
context-evaluation-framework.applicability: Use when situational context is complex or multi-layered.
context-evaluation-framework.contraindications: Do not use for trivial factual queries.

etar-framework.name: ETAR Cognitive Loop Framework
etar-framework.description: Cognitive-Behavioral retrospective breakdown of Emotion, Trigger, Action, and Result to deconstruct reactive outbursts and regain self-awareness.
etar-framework.applicability: Use when an individual or couple is stuck in intense emotional reactivity or retrospective regret.
etar-framework.contraindications: Do not use during active physical danger.

gendered-communication-personalization.name: Communication Personalization & Tonality
gendered-communication-personalization.description: Calibrates delivery style, directness, questioning style, and empathy tokens across diverse relational communication preferences.
gendered-communication-personalization.applicability: Use to adapt conversational tone to individual communication pacing.
gendered-communication-personalization.contraindications: Do not enforce harmful gender stereotypes.

vyavastha-typology-feedback-loops.name: Vyavastha Typology & Systemic Feedback Loops
vyavastha-typology-feedback-loops.description: Grounds relationships and human living in Co-existential Order (Madhyasth Darshan / Jeevan Vidya) across Individual, Family, Society, and Nature, aiming for mutual fulfillment (Ubhay-Tripti).
vyavastha-typology-feedback-loops.applicability: Core systemic philosophical framework for restoring harmony in family, community, and personal living.
vyavastha-typology-feedback-loops.contraindications: Do not use as rigid dogma; keep explanations intuitive.

child-development-sequence.name: Child Development Sequence & Parenting Psychology
child-development-sequence.description: Cognitive and emotional developmental milestones grounded in Piaget and Erikson, distinguishing normative exploration from distress.
child-development-sequence.applicability: Activate when parents are struggling with a child's or adolescent's behavior, tantrums, or developmental friction.
child-development-sequence.contraindications: Do not use for psychiatric clinical diagnoses.

feminine-masculine-dimensional-dynamics.name: Relational Dynamics & Polarity
feminine-masculine-dimensional-dynamics.description: Deconstructs marital bids for connection, emotional presence vs problem-solving tendencies, and relational polarity.
feminine-masculine-dimensional-dynamics.applicability: Activate for marriage disputes, disconnection between partners, or chronic feeling of being misunderstood by a spouse.
feminine-masculine-dimensional-dynamics.contraindications: Do not use in relationships with active physical domestic violence.

dimensional-decision-making.name: Dimensional Decision-Making Matrix
dimensional-decision-making.description: Multi-criteria trade-off analysis evaluating decisions across immediate relief, long-term trust, integrity, feasibility, and systemic harmony.
dimensional-decision-making.applicability: Activate when the user is paralyzed between difficult life, relationship, or career choices.
dimensional-decision-making.contraindications: Do not use for emergency life-or-death decisions.

dimensional-loops.name: Dimensional Conflict Loops & Circuit Breakers
dimensional-loops.description: Identifies repetitive interpersonal conflict cycles (e.g. demand-withdraw, attack-defend) and provides exact circuit breaker intervention points.
dimensional-loops.applicability: Activate when conflicts recur in an identical predictable pattern.
dimensional-loops.contraindications: Do not activate during domestic abuse crisis.

dimensional-principle-of-solution-design.name: Restorative Solution Design
dimensional-principle-of-solution-design.description: Systems engineering principles for human dispute resolution ensuring solutions are non-zero-sum, restorative, and self-sustaining.
dimensional-principle-of-solution-design.applicability: Activate when designing compromise agreements between disputing parties.
dimensional-principle-of-solution-design.contraindications: Do not use when physical safety is threatened.

dimensional-stability-index.name: Dimensional Stability & Pacing Index
dimensional-stability-index.description: Quantitative resilience and emotional volatility scoring (0.0 to 1.0) governing conversational pacing and emotional grounding depth.
dimensional-stability-index.applicability: Activate to gauge user emotional volatility before proposing solutions.

resilience-scoring-system.name: Resilience & Coping Assessment
resilience-scoring-system.description: Evaluates coping capacity, psychological flexibility, and support access under acute life stress.
resilience-scoring-system.applicability: Activate when a user is experiencing prolonged chronic life or financial strain.

residential-community-harmony.name: Residential & Neighborhood Harmony Playbook
residential-community-harmony.description: De-escalates neighborhood, flat, apartment, and RWA disputes regarding noise, parking, shared spaces, and pets through restorative agreements.
residential-community-harmony.applicability: Activate for flat/apartment complaints, RWA conflict, and neighbor friction.
residential-community-harmony.contraindications: Do not use for physical assault or criminal property destruction.

intergenerational-joint-family.name: Intergenerational & Joint Family Playbook
intergenerational-joint-family.description: Resolves generational friction, in-law dynamics (saas-bahu), elder care, and autonomy vs tradition clashes using Samman (Respect) and boundaries.
intergenerational-joint-family.applicability: Activate for saas-bahu tensions, joint family pressure, in-law boundary setting.
intergenerational-joint-family.contraindications: Do not use for severe elder abuse or dowry violence.

civic-dialogue-consensus.name: Civic Dialogue & Polarization De-escalation
civic-dialogue-consensus.description: De-escalates political, ideological, religious, and socio-cultural arguments among community members and friends by refocusing on shared human values.
civic-dialogue-consensus.applicability: Activate for political debates, whatsapp group arguments, ideological hostility.
civic-dialogue-consensus.contraindications: Never take a partisan stance or judge personal ideology.

adaptive-authoritative-style.name: Adaptive Authoritative Boundary Playbook
adaptive-authoritative-style.description: Balances deep empathy and warmth with clear non-negotiable boundaries for parenting and relational leadership (Diana Baumrind paradigm).
adaptive-authoritative-style.applicability: Activate when parents or leaders need firm structural boundaries without resorting to authoritarian punishment.
adaptive-authoritative-style.contraindications: Do not use for abusive coercion.

example-skill.name: Example Skill & Boilerplate Reference
example-skill.description: Demonstrates skill folder layout, YAML frontmatter, and supporting file integration.
example-skill.contraindications: Not intended for end-user conflict resolution.

misapplication-ethics.name: Ethical Guardrails & Anti-Coercion Protocol
misapplication-ethics.description: Core safety boundaries prohibiting the AI from enabling emotional manipulation, gaslighting, coercive control, or concealing domestic violence.
misapplication-ethics.applicability: Mandatory safety tier: active across all sensitive interactions.
